==================
Selector condition before a standalone block
==================
package p
type T struct{Value bool}
func f(x T){
 if !x.Value { println("x") }
 { if x.Value { println("y") } }
}

---

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (type_declaration
    (type_spec
      (type_identifier)
      (struct_type
        (field_declaration_list
          (field_declaration
            (field_identifier)
            (type_identifier))))))
  (function_declaration
    (identifier)
    (parameter_list
      (parameter_declaration
        (identifier)
        (type_identifier)))
    (block
      (statement_list
        (if_statement
          (unary_expression
            (selector_expression
              (identifier)
              (field_identifier)))
          (block
            (statement_list
              (expression_statement
                (call_expression
                  (identifier)
                  (argument_list
                    (interpreted_string_literal
                      (interpreted_string_literal_content))))))))
        (block
          (statement_list
            (if_statement
              (selector_expression
                (identifier)
                (field_identifier))
              (block
                (statement_list
                  (expression_statement
                    (call_expression
                      (identifier)
                      (argument_list
                        (interpreted_string_literal
                          (interpreted_string_literal_content))))))))))))))
